cited.quote: vast number of water bodies yet to be restored

rationale: Extracts cover water-body work under VB-G RAM G (C1, C2), temple renovation (C3, C4) and a hospital building (C5). None shows an official step under the Neeratchi scheme, and the promise's target is unclear. Only related activity.

cited.quote: A 15% subsidy is provided, subject to quantity limits, for procurement of cotton yarn

rationale: C1 shows only an existing 15% yarn price subsidy, not the promised 50% subsidy on yarn, dye and chemicals. No extract shows a step raising it or covering dye and chemicals.

cited.quote: a Turmeric Technology Centre at Bhavanisagar, Erode district will be newly established

rationale: C2 only announces a turmeric technology centre in Erode district (budget statement of intent). It is not a turmeric extraction or sorting park and no GO or tender is shown.

cited.quote: Administrative and financial sanction - Accorded - Orders - Issued
Each Gold Ring will feature a fixed weight of one gram

rationale: C1 is G.O.(Ms) No.166 of 2026-06-23 sanctioning the gold ring scheme for newborns in government institutions; C2 gives specifications. No extract shows the Thaimaman Seer Pettagam kit with fabric and diapers, so only the ring component is implemented.

cited.quote: groundwater recharge, source sustainability, rejuvenation of water bodies, watershed development

rationale: No extract shows a published report on reduction of groundwater extraction for agriculture. C3 and C4 only describe recharge and water-related works.

cited.quote: the Season and Crop Report is prepared annually, containing data on the Nine-fold classification

rationale: C1 describes routine annual crop and land-use reporting, a continuing activity. No extract shows an official assessment measuring an increase of 30 lakh acres in agricultural area.

cited.quote: students of Classes 11 and 12 will be offered specialised elective courses
(TNSPARK) for students of Classes VI to IX

rationale: C4 is a budget announcement (future tense) of a framework for Classes 6 to 12. C1 shows the existing TNSPARK for Classes VI to IX with no date and no new step. No GO or syllabus for Classes 6 to 12 is shown.

cited.quote: Initiative (TN-VETRI) is proposed as an integrated, village-centric development programme

rationale: C1 and C2 describe TN-VETRI as proposed in a policy note. No GO, sanction or selection of 5000 model villages is shown.

cited.quote: the Government from 19.08.2026 has enhanced the milk

rationale: C1 says the Government from 19.08.2026 enhanced the milk procurement price, but no extract states the new price, so Rs 44 per litre cannot be confirmed. Treated as partial, with the date taken from C1.

cited.quote: will be established at Sakkottai near Kumbakonam of Thanjavur district
a new Diploma College for Organic Agriculture, in the name of natural farming scientist Nammalvar

rationale: C1 (budget) and C2 (policy note) say the Nammalvar college will be established at Sakkottai. These are statements of intent; no GO, sanction or tender is shown.

cited.quote: DMHP is a Public Health approach to reach out Mental Health Services

rationale: C1 and C3 describe existing mental health services (DMHP, ECRCs, TeleManas). No extract shows a 10-bed mental health counselling unit attached to community hospitals.

cited.quote: arrange for school students to be taken on educational tours to these sites

rationale: C5, the Governor's address, states the government will arrange school tours to the heritage sites. This is intent only; no GO or tour programme is shown. Other extracts concern different tours.

cited.quote: Press accreditation cards are issued to Reporters / Photographers working in print media

rationale: C1 describes the existing press accreditation card system. No extract shows a step to convert taluk-level local journalists into accredited journalists.

cited.quote: Screen Printing, Yoga and Silambam are provided at the centres located at Chennai

rationale: C1 mentions only part-time Silambam training at existing Jawahar Siruvar Manram centres. No extract shows a plan, GO or establishment of a thousand Silambam training centres.

cited.quote: The CM Dashboard institutionalises data-driven governance by enabling the

rationale: C2 describes an existing Chief Minister's Dashboard, with no dated new step. No extract shows the Tamil Nadu Official Monitoring Platform (Real Time Governance Dashboard) being brought into operation.

cited.quote: The Tamil Nadu Lokayukta has been constituted with a Chairperson, two Judicial Members

rationale: C1 describes the Lokayukta under the 2018 Act. No extract shows an amendment or step for a transparent appointment method or prosecution powers.

cited.quote: residential consumers are eligible to install rooftop solar systems with Central Financial Assistance

rationale: C2 shows only the Union PM Surya Ghar subsidy (Rs 30,000 per kW up to 2 kW; Rs 78,000 for 3 kW and above). No extract shows a state subsidy of Rs 35,000, 70,000 or 1 lakh.
The promise names an unspecified scheme and a Rs 23,000 crore five-year district development spend. No extract is about that commitment; C1 covers VB-GRAM G outlay, a different scheme.

cited.quote: cooperative societies operate 36,318 Fair Price Shops

rationale: C4 and C2 discuss fair price shops generally. No extract shows any order appointing weighers in rural ration shops or the gender-matching arrangement.

cited.quote: introduced a registration framework to regulate and promote the emerging caravan tourism concept

rationale: C1 reports a caravan park and operator registration framework, undated and not a caravan tourism policy. C2 and C3 mention a Sustainable Tourism Policy only as a plan. No dated official policy is shown.
